name: PM-KISAN
benefit: Central income support of Rs 6,000 per year in three instalments
how_to_apply: Apply at pmkisan.gov.in (Farmers Corner) or via Common Service Centre / village agriculture office. Need Aadhaar, land records, bank account.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance)
benefit: Insurance cover against crop loss from drought, flood, pests and disease
how_to_apply: Enrol through your bank, CSC or pmfby.gov.in before the crop-season cut-off date.
documents: Land records or tenancy / sowing declaration

name: Kisan Credit Card
benefit: Low-interest short-term crop loans for farmers
how_to_apply: Apply at your bank branch or cooperative bank with land records, Aadhaar and photo.

name: Andhra Pradesh state farmer support (e.g. Annadata Sukhibhava)
benefit: State income support for farmer families (amount and rules change; confirm current details)
how_to_apply: Contact the Rythu Seva Kendram (RSK) in your village.

name: Soil Health Card
benefit: Free soil testing and a crop-wise fertiliser recommendation card for your field, renewed every two years
how_to_apply: Ask the village agriculture office / Rythu Seva Kendram to collect a soil sample from your field, or register at soilhealth.dac.gov.in.
documents: Survey / khata number of the field

name: e-NAM (online mandi trading)
benefit: Sell your produce online to buyers across many mandis, with transparent bidding and payment to your bank account
how_to_apply: Register at enam.gov.in or at your nearest e-NAM linked mandi (APMC) office; the mandi staff help with registration.

name: PM Kisan Maan-Dhan (farmer pension)
benefit: Pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60 for small and marginal farmers who join at age 18 to 40 and pay a small monthly contribution (Rs 55 to Rs 200), matched by the government
how_to_apply: Enrol at a Common Service Centre or at pmkmy.gov.in. Contribution can be auto-debited from your bank account.

name: PMKSY Per Drop More Crop (drip and sprinkler subsidy)
benefit: Subsidy on drip and sprinkler irrigation systems to save water; the subsidy rate depends on your state and farmer category
how_to_apply: Apply through the agriculture / horticulture office or Rythu Seva Kendram of your mandal; they tell you the approved suppliers and the subsidy rate for your category.

name: PM-KUSUM (solar pump subsidy)
benefit: Subsidy on solar-powered irrigation pumps, so you can cut diesel or electricity cost; central and state support, farmer pays the balance
how_to_apply: Apply through your state nodal agency or the portal at pmkusum.mnre.gov.in; the agriculture / electricity department office tells you the current window.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (storage and processing loans)
benefit: Loans up to Rs 2 crore with 3% interest subvention for up to 7 years for storage, cold chain, sorting and other post-harvest facilities
how_to_apply: Apply on agriinfra.dac.gov.in with a project report and a bank; farmer groups and FPOs also qualify.
